poses.label: Hang
poses.description: Set your hinge and let your arms hang long under your shoulders.

poses.label: Pull
poses.description: Pull the bar toward your lower ribs while holding your torso still.

poses.label: Top
poses.description: Briefly hold the bar near your lower ribs with your elbows back.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Lower under control until your arms are long again.
